# Weekly Postcards travel facts — 19 October 2026

The owner requested one or two weekly subscriber emails with interesting facts about visited destinations and links to relevant blog/site pages, starting from 28 October 2026 with the first public destination release. In response to the cadence/time question, he selected once per week on Wednesday (proposed time: 12:00 Netherlands time).

## Created schedule

- App automation ID: `wekelijkse-postcards-met-reisweetjes`.
- Name: Wekelijkse Postcards met reisweetjes.
- Kind/destination: heartbeat returning to this chat; status ACTIVE, verified through the app's view tool.

## Edition content and delivery

Each short English email includes a subject, preview, 2–3 varied facts checked against reliable primary sources, an optional genuine personal connection based only on published owner content, an existing approved photo if appropriate, and a clear link to a relevant live canonical blog, Journey or Field Notes page. Store fact-source links in the ledger below. Never invent experiences, reveal future/private destinations or reuse stale facts without checking.

Send through the existing verified Postcards sender and existing Brevo list 3 with explicit Email campaigns subscriptions = Subscribed. Preserve design, sender identity, privacy/support and unsubscribe. Respect suppression and current free limits. No imports, pending-contact conversion, silent resubscription, new credentials, paid upgrades or account configuration changes.

Check campaign history and this ledger before each edition; at most one factual edition per calendar week. Avoid duplicate content and same-day duplicates with owner-approved new-content campaigns by combining where appropriate. Resume/check an existing campaign when sending is ambiguous. Record actual status, not assumed delivery.

## Runtime and limitations

This is a local Codex chat schedule, not a new background service in Firebase or Brevo. The owner's computer must be on with Codex running, the source folder available and Brevo accessible through the existing authenticated browser. Runtime, session, fact-checking, quota or provider failures can prevent a send. The task must report required action, preserve a draft where possible and never claim an unsent edition was sent.

No email or campaign was created/sent during setup; the first destination/content cannot be prepared until it is publicly revealed. No website functionality, backend configuration, sender/template or live page was modified for this task. Local instruction/report backup: `backups/website_2026-10-19_11-17-33`.

No editions sent yet. Future entries must contain week/date, subject, public destination/page URL, primary fact-source links, existing or new campaign ID and draft/queued/sent/delivered status. Do not record subscriber addresses, tokens or credentials.
